Author: Nainaiowo
Name: Better Deaths
Description: Records party deaths with pull grouping, fatal events, active statuses, and recent action timelines.
Changelog: Fixed shared status ownership so one caster's effect expiring cannot remove or refresh another caster's matching effect. Tightened combined damage-over-time eligibility at exact removal boundaries and added diagnostics for remaining tick and calibration differences. Added captured multi-caster regression coverage while preserving direct damage, encounter timing, and existing content restrictions.
